means: Smearing along the direction of movement, as a real shutter records a moving subject.
does: On this model it softens the whole frame rather than only the moving part, so faces and edges lose definition and the image reads as out of focus instead of fast.
reach_for_it: never in the positive. Speed comes from `motion lines`, `speed lines` and the post-processing fx chain, all of which are exact.
used_in: the standing negative prompt of every anime keyframe in this project
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
